title: Create Apliiq account for premium polo upgrade path
detail: Sign up at apliiq.com (free). Apliiq is POD with no MOQ but supports custom woven neck labels and premium piqué fabric — the single biggest premium upgrade BV can make without capital. Once the account exists and is connected to the BV Shopify store, I can pull their catalog and materialize an upgraded "Black Vault Polo" with a custom "Black Vault — Built to be Kept" neck label in place of the Port Authority tag. About 10 minutes of your time.
why: Account creation requires your email, business info, and Shopify OAuth — I can't sign up on your behalf.
